title: United States Army Aviation Museum

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: The US Army Aviation Museum and Gift Shop are closed on Sundays, Mondays, and all Federal Holidays. There is a $5 per student donation required for all field trips; estimations are allowed within a count of 5 students. Exceptions may apply. No amount is due until the field trip has been approved. A confirmation email and donation request will be sent upon approval. The Army Aviation Museum is located on a military installation. Gate access may require additional identification and must be completed individually prior to arrival. This is the official website of the Army Aviation Museum Foundation, a non-profit organization that supports the United States Army Aviation Museum. The Foundation
